methods.comment:
* Returns the default ServiceWorkerController instance. At present there is * only one ServiceWorkerController instance for all WebView instances, * however this restriction may be relaxed in the future. * *

* This method should only be called if * {@link WebViewFeature#isFeatureSupported(String)} * returns true for {@link WebViewFeature#SERVICE_WORKER_BASIC_USAGE}. * * @return the default ServiceWorkerController instance

methods.comment:
* * Sets the client to capture service worker related callbacks. *

* A {@link ServiceWorkerClientCompat} should be set before any service workers are * active, e.g. a safe place is before any WebView instances are created or * pages loaded. *
